We’re introducing a financially backed promise designed to deliver faster repairs, better communication, and greater peace of mind – exclusively available on machines enrolled in a Premium CVA that was opened after March 1, 2026. | How do you benefit from having a Services Commitment CVA? | Parts Availability | Receive qualifying maintenance or common repair parts when promised – or receive the price of the part, up to $1,000 in Cat® Credits. | Service Response | Field Repairs – Second business day completion on common repairs for a downed machine, or receive the cost of labor, up to $1,000 in Cat® Credits. | Shop Repairs – Committed completion date provided and met after the scope of work is agreed on - or receive the cost of labor, up to $1,000 in Cat® Credits. | How does a Services Commitment CVA Work? | Parts – Order parts for your Premium CVA enrolled equipment over the counter, on Parts.Cat.Com or through the Cat® Central App. Make sure to enter your machine’s serial number and the date you need the parts by. We guarantee fulfillment of over 100K maintenance and common repair parts by the need-by date you specify. If we can’t get you the part on or before the promised date, you’ll receive the price of the part, up to $1,000 in Cat® Credits. | Field Repairs – If your Premium CVA-backed machine goes down in the field, contact your Ring Power branch and the dispatcher will send a technician your way. If the job is a common repair, requiring an initial repair time estimate of 12 labor hours or less and common repair parts, we commit to getting your machine up and running within two business days from your initial call. If we cannot meet that promise, you’ll receive the cost of labor, up to $1,000 in Cat® Credits. | Shop Repairs – We’ll provide you with a committed completion date after you review and agree on the scope of work. If we miss the completion date, you’ll receive the cost of labor, up to $1,000 in Cat® Credits.
